# wok: brief

## Ideas

| at | meaning | idea 1 (device: idea, typicality) | idea 2 | idea 3 | idea 4 | chosen (1 to 4) | why |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| s1 | the app is thinking | literal: a spinner circles above the send button, 0.8 | transformation: the send button grows into a wok that tosses the ingredients, 0.15 | personification: the cursor sweats and fans itself, 0.3 | scale shift: zoom into one pixel that boils, 0.2 | 2 | because the wok comes from the kitchen and the button carries over |
| s2 | the answer is ready | literal: the reply card slides in from below, 0.85 | literalise: the plate is served under a steel cloche, 0.4 | reversal: the diner sends food back to the cook, 0.1 | show the invisible: the steam spells the reply, 0.25 | 4 | because steam is the hidden heat of the answer |
| s3 | one tap orders it | metaphor: a bell on a pass rings once, 0.35 | part for whole: one chopstick lifts the whole feast, 0.2 | collision: a taxi horn sounds in a quiet kitchen, 0.12 | literal: the order button turns green, 0.9 | 1 | because the service bell is the kitchen's own sound for done |
| s1 to s2 | the wok pours into the plate | transformation: the wok tilts and the sauce floods the frame, 0.2 | literal: a crossfade, 0.9 | scale shift: the steam rises past the camera, 0.3 | reversal: the frame empties then refills, 0.4 | 1 | because the sauce is the shared element |
